frontmatter.title: Formula Sheet
frontmatter.description: One page holding every formula the course uses, from softmax to McNemar's exact test. Each entry says in plain English what the formula does, shows the formula, defines every symbol including the operators, reads the whole thing out loud as one sentence, works a small numeric instance with every step shown, and tells you how to check your answer.

This is the course formula sheet. It collects every named formula in the book, in the order
the chapters introduce them, and it is meant to sit open beside you while you work.

Nothing on this page needs calculus. Nothing on this page assumes you remember high-school
algebra either. If a symbol is unfamiliar, it has a row in a table telling you how to say it
and what it means.

“Temperature makes the model more creative.” It does not. The model produced one
distribution over 151,936 tokens; temperature reshapes that distribution and nothing else.
It adds no new candidate, removes none, and cannot promote a token above one that outranked
it. What changes is how often the sampler reaches past the leader, which is a fact about the
sampler, not about the model’s imagination.
